title: Location names in the menu and column match the location switcher
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations, so the location switcher lists both.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every bucket expanded (Expand all).
custom_steps:
1. Open the location switcher in the top right of ShopView and read the two location names.
  2. Close the switcher without switching.
  3. Click the Location chip and read the two names.
  4. Read the Location column.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The switcher names location A and location B.

Step 2:

  • You are still at location A.

Step 3:

  • The menu names them exactly as the switcher does, letter for letter.

Step 4:

  • The Location column uses the same names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R4: “Each location is named exactly as the location switcher in the top right of ShopView names it, and the Location column uses the same name.”
